name: FNaF 2: Night of Misfits
storyline:
Welcome here to Freddy Fazbear's Pizza !

In the FNaF 2 Night of Misfits game, a new security guard named Jeremy Fitzgerald takes a job on the night shift at the new and improved Freddy Fazbber's Pizza, famous for its animatronic robots, to which new characters have been added. The previous security guard experienced difficulties, claiming that the characters were roaming the establishment and attempted to break into the office, so he was reassigned to the day shift. You were advised to use Bonnie's empty rabbit head from the spare parts room and hide under a desk to knock the animatronics to the ground and force them to leave you alone. You were also given a flashlight. Left alone on night duty, you notice that both new and old puppets are slowly approaching the control room, starting a creepy game of survival!

What could possibly go wrong?

As the new guard, your job will be to keep an eye on the cameras and make sure nothing happens after hours. The entire building is powered by two generators that must be on throughout the night. If something goes wrong, namely if Freddy or his friends are not in their seats, you will need to find them on the monitors and protect yourself if necessary!

Remember, your safety inside the pizzeria depends on your vigilance and ability to manage the situation. Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for death or dismemberment.
summary: "FNaF 2 Night of Misfits" is a fan game created as an unofficial project based on Scott Cawthon's Five Nights at Freddy's. It is a non-commercial creative incarnation developed from scratch and differs from the original in both mechanics and story. It is important to note that "FNaF 2 Night of Misfits" is not an official or free version of "Five Nights at Freddy's" and is not to be distributed for money
